title: 第 97章 吃顿饭都不消停

众人进入餐厅，引来了大厅中很多人的注视。毕竟二十多人一起来，声势还是有些大的。

王野还是第一次在这种注视中进入餐厅，多多少少还是有些羞耻感的。可是一起同行的这帮人，个顶个的昂首挺胸，好像非常自豪。

众人在服务员的引导下走向一个长桌入座，并不是王野他们不想去包厢，而是这里的包厢一般不对外使用。

当然如果这帮人真要是闹起来，餐厅的经理也会把他们安排进包厢。但是这事儿要是传进他们父辈儿那里，一定是跑不了的。

为了这点小事儿，挨顿揍太不值当了，再说了在大厅里才能更加满足他们的虚荣心。

点菜的工作交给了黄飞龙，看着他熟练的动作，王野相信这群人肯定经常来这里。就在众人你一嘴他一嘴的吹牛中，一道道的美味端上了餐桌。

王野虽然没有在高档西餐厅吃过饭，但是前世团过那种百八十块钱的西餐，去之前还特意查了吃西餐的流程。所以吃起来比这些人更规矩一点儿。

最起码他没有向服务员要筷子，王野并不反对用筷子吃西餐，反而还很支持这种行为。吃西餐也没有谁规定过必须使用刀叉，这全凭个人喜好。如果他愿意，就算是下手抓都不是问题。

但是有人却看不惯了，一声不和谐的声音传了过来：“一群土鳖。”

就这一句话，一桌二十多人立刻齐刷刷的看向声音的来源。王野摇了摇头，心里不由的腹诽：“真踏马不让消停。”

王野在对面的桌子上，和他们一样也有二三十号人。这些人也同样看向王野他们这边，就在王野看他们的时候，两边已经开始对骂了，那真是上到祖宗十八代，下到人体器官，无所不用其极。

王野可不会站起来跟他们对骂，旁边的秦天熙也老神在在的看着双方表演。王野小声的问道：“大哥，这种场面经常发生吗？”

秦天熙苦笑答道：“也不是经常，每个月总有那么两次。”

王野：“对面什么来头？”

“老冤家了，还记得我下午跟你说的那个大院吗？”

王野吃惊的问道：“我擦，这么多年了，还没和解呀？”

秦天熙：“和解个屁，从小到大，恩恩怨怨多了，这一桩桩，一件件的都够写本书了。”

王野不屑的说道：“就这，打一回叫一回家长，也不是个事儿呀？”

“怎么可能呢，当时我们岁数都小，又是第一次冲突，家长才掺和进来了，后来就不管了。这要是回回叫家长，那他们的脸也不用要了。”

王野好奇的问道：“大哥，以你的经验，今天这架势能打起来不？”

秦天熙想了一下：“八九不离十，看见对面还坐着的那个了吗？”

秦天熙看向对面坐的青年，看样子二十多岁，干干净净，头发梳的一丝不苟。也和秦天熙一样安安静静的吃着饭，好像吵架的那桌人和他没关系一样。

王野点点头，秦天熙继续说道：“那是他们的头儿，叫楚材，他爹是来头也不小，最主要的是这小子在我手里吃过亏，这么好的报仇机会他可不会放过。”

王野：“这算什么好机会呀，两面人数差不多，又是打了这么多年的老冤家了，胜负最多五五开。”

秦天熙不屑的说道：“你信不信，餐厅外面最少还有二十多号人？”

Everyone entered the restaurant, attracting the attention of many people in the hall.After all, with more than 20 people coming together, the momentum was quite big.

This was the first time Wang Ye entered a restaurant under such gaze, and he still felt a little ashamed.But the group of people walking together held their heads high and seemed very proud.

Under the guidance of the waiter, everyone walked to a long table and took their seats. It was not that Wang Ye and the others did not want to go to the private room, but that the private rooms here were generally not used by the public.

Of course, if these people really get into trouble, the restaurant manager will put them in a private room.But if this matter reaches their parents, they will definitely not be able to escape.

It's not worth getting beaten for such a trivial matter, and besides, their vanity can be more satisfied in the hall.

The task of ordering food was handed over to Huang Feilong. Looking at his skillful movements, Wang Ye believed that this group of people must come here often.While everyone was bragging, one after another delicious food was served on the table.

Although Wang Ye has never eaten in a high-end Western restaurant, he had eaten Western food that cost 180 yuan in his previous life, and he even checked the process of eating Western food before going there.So I eat a little more disciplinedly than these people.

At least he didn't ask the waiter for chopsticks. Wang Ye was not opposed to using chopsticks to eat Western food, but actually supported this behavior.No one stipulates that you must use a knife and fork when eating Western food. It all depends on personal preference.If he is willing, even grabbing it won't be a problem.

But some people couldn't stand it, and a discordant voice came over: "A bunch of bumpkins."

With this sentence, more than 20 people at the table immediately looked at the source of the sound.Wang Ye shook his head and couldn't help but curse in his heart: "It's really hard to stop."

Wang Ye was at the table opposite, and there were twenty or thirty people like them.These people also looked at Wang Ye and the others. When Wang Ye looked at them, the two sides had already begun to curse. It was really about eighteen generations of ancestors, down to human organs, and everything.

Wang Ye would not stand up and scold them. Qin Tianxi next to him was also watching the performances of both parties.Wang Ye asked in a low voice: "Brother, does this kind of scene happen often?"

Qin Tianxi smiled bitterly and replied: "It's not often, there are always twice a month."

Wang Ye: "What's the background of the other side?"

"Old enemies, do you remember the compound I told you about this afternoon?"

Wang Ye asked in surprise: "Oh my god, after so many years, there is still no reconciliation?"

Qin Tianxi: "Reconciliation is nothing. Ever since we were young, we have had so many grievances and grievances. Each one of them is enough to write a book."

Wang Ye said disdainfully: "That's it, calling the parents once is not a big deal, right?"

"How is that possible? We were young at the time, and it was our first conflict. Our parents got involved, and then they ignored us. If we call our parents back, they don't have to worry about it."

Wang Ye asked curiously: "Brother, based on your experience, can you fight with this posture today?"

Qin Tianxi thought for a moment: "It's almost the same. Have you seen the one sitting opposite?"

Qin Tianxi looked at the young man sitting opposite him. He looked to be in his twenties, clean and neat, with his hair combed meticulously.Like Qin Tianxi, he ate his meal quietly, as if the people at the table who were quarreling had nothing to do with him.

Wang Ye nodded, and Qin Tianxi continued: "That's their leader, his name is Chu Cai. His father has a good background. The most important thing is that this kid has suffered losses at my hands. He will not let go of such a good opportunity for revenge."

Wang Ye: "What a good opportunity this is. There are almost the same number of people on both sides, and they are old enemies who have been fighting for so many years. The outcome is 50-50 at best."

Qin Tianxi said disdainfully: "Do you believe it or not, there are at least twenty people outside the restaurant?"
